en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist building complex with bold, angled facades and large awnings, identified as the Olympia Restaurant. The scene includes curved roads with buses, pedestrians, streetlights, landscaped areas, and low hills in the background. The reverse side has Hungarian text, a vertical publisher line, printed price, and standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp box.
